title: Present authoritative match-entry acknowledgement without inventing gameplay
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/DESIGN_RECONCILIATION.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md and your frozen export contract in docs/PILOT100_UI_CONTRACTS.md before coding. Implement only your owned leaf module using installed React/TypeScript/testing dependencies. Export the exact named component and readonly props/types from index.tsx; keep module-local styles and tests inside that directory. Do not import an unmerged A/B task, edit App.tsx/shared barrels/manifests/task metadata or silently change another contract. This is controlled recipient-safe presentation, not an authority or complete application. Authority state/capabilities and semantic callbacks are supplied; no Firebase/native/store/network calls, secret caching, clock-driven game transitions, asset generation or fabricated success. Use original neutral-frost chrome, semantic HTML/keyboard access and honest unavailable media/provider states. Overlay leaves supply content to the separately composed modal host; do not claim global focus blocking in a content-only leaf. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, credentials, cloud deployment or budget changes. Preserve concise handoff, observed validation/failures and unknown costs under the benchmark policy. Render the documented City signal acquired / Entering the blackout cinematic handoff as controlled preparation/acknowledged/failed presentation. No role reveal or playable fake engine is created. The authority/presentation host owns the brief handoff timing and route change; reduced motion retains clear transition text. Own only apps/client/src/pilot100/match-entry/; provide index.tsx exporting MatchEntryTransition, MatchEntryTransitionProps and any named local types documented for B045. This task consumes part of A033; do not double-count it as a second implementation of that broad work. Run scoped React tests/lint/typecheck and node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; report actual results and unresolved application integration.
acceptance: Preparing never claims that a match has started before acknowledged state.
Failed state shows supplied safe text and cancellation without assigning roles or starting timers.
Reduced motion removes decorative travel and no internal timer advances gameplay or routes.
Exact frozen export/readonly props are implemented and scoped lint/typecheck/meaningful React tests plus node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full pass; only owned files change.
